The glaring vulnerability of personal digital data to malicious actors exploiting platform dynamics for clout.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Mistaking illegal digital surveillance and harassment (WHO/HOW) for legitimate tech commentary or security auditing (WHAT).

Social Physics Analysis:
The actor ran a classic smart selfish maneuver, leveraging unauthorized data access under a cyber-vigilantism pretext to harvest attention and dominate engagement metrics at the direct expense of victims' privacy and safety.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic extraction replaces genuine security.

The Unavoidable Truth: Digital privacy is routinely compromised for viral social media clout.

The Unavoidable Lie: Self-styled hackers are protecting users when they actually exploit them.

Digital vigilantism often masks predatory extraction under the guise of technical expertise. 🌐

Brothekanon:
Imagine flexing about tracking people's phones online and acting surprised when the cops show up with a felony warrant.

Using digital surveillance to exploit others inevitably traps the perpetrator in their own web of deceit.
